components.name: Progress Register
components.description: Shows completed, current, and pending workflow stages.

narrative.overview: Beat ATS feels like reviewing a clean proof copy with a careful editor. Factual source material remains visible, proposed changes are deliberate, and verification is more important than spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Verification green is reserved for confirmed progress and primary actions.
Thin rules and spacing establish hierarchy.
Source, suggestion, warning, and accepted states remain distinguishable.

rules.name: The Verification Rule
rules.body: Green means an action or state has been deliberately confirmed; it is not decorative.

rules.name: The Flat Proof Rule
rules.body: Never combine a border and a large shadow on the same container.

dos: Do keep the current task and recovery action visible during long AI operations.
Do distinguish source text, AI suggestions, and accepted edits with labels.
Do preserve generous reading width and direct, factual interface copy.
donts: Don't turn the workflow into a score game or imply a hiring guarantee.
Don't use nested cards, gradients, glass effects, or decorative document icons.
Don't hide privacy, consent, cost-triggering actions, or stale-analysis status.
